name: tests-75pct-python-polylith-stable-machine-readable-adf8
instr:
Support JSON outcomes in Poetry dependency, diff and information command adapters. Selecting format json emits their workflow's payload with command identities poly deps, poly diff and poly info and status 0. Preserve selected dependency uses, used_by and interfaces. Information output retains supplied project-filtered, grouped, development and short-mode inventory, including project bases/components.

Encode one envelope with exactly command, success, payload, warnings, errors and mutations. Errors encode code, message and context; mutations encode path, changed and details. Keep warnings separate from fatal errors. Equivalent results encode identically, with lexical object keys and sorted set members. Paths become POSIX strings and None becomes null.

CreatedResource encodes kind, name and path, retaining base/component/project/workspace distinctions. Failed creation or missing-tag result envelopes have success false, null payload and no mutations. Missing workspace names fail with one JSON document before creation. CreateBase rejects unsupported format yaml with ValueError or SystemExit before creation.

Dependency payloads sort bricks, uses members and circular-group members, and retain distinct uses/used_by/interfaces. Diff payloads retain tag, sorted direct bases/components/projects and separate dependent collections. Sync payloads retain caller project order, changed/unchanged/unsupported flags and mutation observations without converting an explicitly failed envelope
